llm_response.reason: The website exhibits multiple scam characteristics: aggressive marketing language ('hot sale', '100% secure', 'free delivery'), an unusually broad range of branded products resembling a legitimate company (North Sails), lack of visible company credentials/contact details, no hyperlinks for navigation or customer service, generic privacy/information assurance, and a very recent domain registration with redacted ownership info and registration in China while targeting European shoppers. It mimics legitimate branding and offers none of the standard transparency or legitimacy signals found in genuine e-commerce stores.
